responsibility: Declares a lightweight utility class used by analyzer dumps to print textual bar charts. It defines the item storage and public API for adding named counters and pretty-printing them as aligned, scaled bars, supporting diagnostics and statistics presentation rather than core symbolic execution.
same_name_distinction: Declares the lightweight bar_chart utility class and its item storage/API for dump rendering. Unlike bar-chart.cc, it exposes the data structure and methods without implementing the chart-printing calculations.
